caption.body:
7 export documents every beginner needs for the first shipment.

Most first-time exporters lose time because one paper is missing or does not match another. Start with the commercial invoice and packing list, then the shipping bill and bill of lading or airway bill. Set up your IEC and customs login early, and ask your buyer which product certificates apply in their country. For payment, know the proforma invoice, the letter of credit and the e-BRC.

The rules and forms change, so confirm the current steps on the official sites or with your customs broker before you file.
